recognize_zh: 這是側位頭顱 X 光：整個顱骨穹窿散布許多小圓形透亮點，邊界尚清楚、大小不一，呈多發性小溶骨病灶的樣子；在淋巴瘤合併高血鈣的病例中，代表骨骼侵犯或骨吸收，需與骨髓瘤的打洞樣病灶和副甲狀腺機能亢進的鹽與胡椒顱骨區分。
features: Numerous small, round, scattered lucencies throughout the calvarium
Lesions relatively well-defined, variable in size, without sclerotic rims
No large solitary destructive lesion or pathologic fracture evident
Dentition and skull base visualized; patient appears young
describe_en: This is a lateral skull radiograph rather than a morphologic specimen. Innumerable small, round, relatively well-defined lucencies without sclerotic margins are scattered throughout the calvarium, giving a mottled appearance. No large solitary destructive lesion is evident. In a patient with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and hypercalcemia, the findings are consistent with multifocal osteolytic involvement or accelerated bone resorption; correlation with PTH, PTHrP and 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D levels and cross-sectional imaging is recommended.

ddx.vs: Classically shows larger punched-out lytic lesions of the skull, with serum/urine M-protein and clonal marrow plasma cells.
Produces a fine granular 'salt-and-pepper' skull with subperiosteal resorption of the phalanges and elevated PTH rather than discrete lytic foci.
Usually fewer, larger lytic lesions with beveled edges ('hole within a hole'), confirmed by CD1a/langerin-positive cells on biopsy.
Separated by primary tumor identification and biopsy showing non-hematolymphoid tumor cells.
